items.title: 18.1.1 Electronic Configuration of Transition Metals and their Ions (transition metals aur un ke ions ki electronic configuration) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.1.1 with Table 18.1, printed page 16.

blocks.text: Transition elements ki electronic configuration aam tor par Aufbau principle (kam energy wale orbital pehle bharne ka rule) ke mutabiq hoti hai, siwaye chromium aur copper ke. Yeh dono anomaly (rule se hat kar) dikhate hain, kyun ke aadha bhara (chromium; 3d⁵) aur poora bhara (copper; 3d¹⁰) d-subshell zyada stable hota hai. Is stability se in ka electron cloud zyada symmetrical (barabar phaila hua) hota hai aur nucleus ko behtar shielding milti hai. Pehli row ke transition elements ki neutral (M⁰), dipositive (M²⁺) aur tripositive (M³⁺) oxidation states ki configurations Table 18.1 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 18.1 Pehli row ke transition elements ki electronic configurations

blocks.title: Pehle kaun se electrons jate hain?
blocks.text: Ion bante waqt 4s electrons 3d electrons se pehle nikalte hain. Is liye Fe ([Ar] 3d⁶4s²) se Fe²⁺ [Ar] 3d⁶ aur phir Fe³⁺ [Ar] 3d⁵ banta hai. Table mein har M²⁺ aur M³⁺ ka 4s⁰ isi liye hai.

blocks.prompt: Mn²⁺ ki electronic configuration likhein aur batayein ke yeh khaas tor par stable kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: [Ar] 3d⁵ 4s⁰: 3d subshell bilkul aadha bhara (half-filled) hai, jo stable hota hai.

items: Cr [Ar] 3d⁵4s¹ aur Cu [Ar] 3d¹⁰4s¹ Aufbau se hat kar hain (half-filled aur completely filled d-subshell).
Ions pehle 4s, phir 3d electrons khote hain.
